How to use

  • Dilute 5 drops into a tablespoon of jojoba and massage into the scalp.
  • Leave for 30 minutes before washing, two or three times a week.
  • Diffuse 3 drops with peppermint while working.

Dilute before applying to skin and patch-test first. Not for internal use.

Scent profile

  • Pine
  • Camphor
  • Green herb

What's in it

  • 100% pure Rosmarinus officinalis leaf oil

Who it's for

Hair and scalp routines

By a distance the most common reason this is bought, usually diluted into jojoba for a scalp massage.

Study and desk work

Sharp and green, and it pairs naturally with peppermint for a focus blend.

People who like herbal scents

Closer to the garden than to perfume, which is exactly the appeal for some and not for others.

What people get wrong

Using it neat on the scalp. Five drops in a tablespoon of carrier is the right strength. Neat rosemary on skin is both unnecessary and a reliable route to irritation.

Expecting results in a fortnight. Hair routines work on the timescale of hair, which is months. People try it for three weeks, see nothing and stop.

What it won't do

We are not going to tell you it regrows hair. There is published research people find encouraging, but we sell an essential oil, not a treatment, and claiming otherwise would be both dishonest and unlawful here.

Avoid it in pregnancy, and if you have epilepsy or high blood pressure, ask a doctor before using it at all.

We describe how our oils smell and how people use them. We don't make medical claims, because essential oils aren't medicine.

Questions about Rosemary

Does rosemary oil help hair growth?

We cannot make that claim and we are not going to. There is research people find interesting, and it is overwhelmingly the reason customers buy it, but an essential oil is not a medicine and Indian advertising rules are clear about what we may say.

How do I use it for a scalp massage?

Five drops into a tablespoon of jojoba or sweet almond, massaged into the scalp, left for around thirty minutes and then washed out. Two or three times a week is what most people settle on.

Which chemotype is this?

The 1,8-cineole type, which is the one used in most of the published work and the one usually meant when people ask for rosemary oil. Camphor and verbenone chemotypes smell and behave differently.

How long does it keep once opened?

Two to three years stored properly — cool, dark and tightly closed. Distilled oils keep considerably better than cold-pressed citrus.

What dilution should I use on skin?

Lower than most. Avoid during pregnancy and if you have epilepsy or high blood pressure. For general use, dilute into a carrier oil such as jojoba and patch-test on a small area first.

Can I take it internally?

No. None of our oils are food grade and none are sold for internal use. Essential oils are extremely concentrated, and advice to add them to water or food is not advice we endorse.

How quickly will it arrive?

Orders are dispatched from Delhi within two business days and usually arrive within a further three to five, depending on where you are. Shipping is free over ₹999.
